# Mpx 开发指南

本 Skill 提供了 Mpx 框架的基础开发指南索引。Mpx 是一款致力于提高小程序开发体验和开发效率的增强型小程序框架。

## 1. Mpx 框架简介
Mpx 是对小程序原生开发标准的补强和扩充，支持单文件开发、数据响应、增强模板语法等。
- **详细介绍**: [intro.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/intro.md)

## 2. 快速开始
- **项目创建与运行**: [start.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/start.md)
- **项目结构**: [project-structure.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/project-structure.md)
- **IDE 配置**: [ide.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/ide.md)

## 3. 核心概念
Mpx 的核心由 App、Page 和 Component 组成。
- **App (应用实例)**: [app.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/app.md) - 介绍 App 的生命周期、全局配置等。
- **Page (页面)**: [page.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/page.md) - 介绍页面的创建、生命周期、配置等。
- **Component (组件)**: [component.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/component.md) - 介绍自定义组件的创建、属性、生命周期、插槽等。

## 4. 基础语法
Mpx 支持类似 Vue 的开发体验。
- **单文件组件 (SFC)**: [single-file.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/single-file.md)
- **模板语法**: [template.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/template.md)

- **Class 与 Style 绑定**: [class-style-binding.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/class-style-binding.md)

## 5. 响应式系统
Mpx 提供了强大的数据响应能力。
- **响应式原理**: [reactive.md](file:///Users/didi/work/mpx/docs-vitepress/guide/basic/reactive.md) - 包含 watch, computed 等。

<script>
import { createComponent } from '@mpxjs/core'
import campaignTracker from '@business/campaign-tracker-web'

createComponent({
  properties: {
    campaignId: {
      type: String,
      observer () {
        this.initTracker()
      }
    },
    memberId: String
  },
  data: {
    ready: false
  },
  ready () {
    this.initTracker()
  },
  detached () {
    this.tracker.destroy()
  },
  methods: {
    async initTracker () {
      if (!this.campaignId) return
      this.ready = false
      const tracker = await campaignTracker.create({
        campaignId: this.campaignId,
        memberId: this.memberId
      })
      this.tracker = tracker
      window.addEventListener('message', this.handleWindowMessage)
      document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', this.handleVisibilityChange)
      tracker.start()
      this.ready = true
      this.triggerEvent('ready', { campaignId: this.campaignId })
    },
    handleWindowMessage (event) {
      const message = event.data || {}
      if (message.type === 'campaign-exposure') {
        this.tracker.track('exposure', message.payload)
      }
    },
    handleVisibilityChange () {
      if (document.hidden) {
        this.tracker.pause()
      } else {
        this.tracker.resume()
      }
    }
  }
})
</script>

import { createPage } from '@mpxjs/core'

createPage({
  data: {
    memberId: 'member-10086',
    campaignId: 'summer-sale',
    campaigns: [
      { id: 'summer-sale', name: '夏日特卖' },
      { id: 'member-day', name: '会员日' },
      { id: 'fresh-week', name: '生鲜周' }
    ],
    campaign: {
      title: '夏日清凉特卖',
      subtitle: '限时领券，爆款低至五折'
    },
    campaignUrl: 'https://campaign.example.com/summer-sale?memberId=member-10086',
    loading: true,
    errorText: '',
    trackerReady: false
  },
  methods: {
    switchCampaign (campaignId) {
      if (campaignId === this.campaignId) return
      this.campaignId = campaignId
      this.loading = true
      this.errorText = ''
      this.campaignUrl = `https://campaign.example.com/${campaignId}?memberId=${this.memberId}`
    },
    handleCampaignLoad () {
      this.loading = false
      wx.reportAnalytics('campaign_webview_load', {
        campaign_id: this.campaignId
      })
    },
    handleCampaignError () {
      this.loading = false
      this.errorText = '活动会场暂时无法打开'
    },
    handleCampaignMessage (event) {
      const messages = event.detail.data || []
      const message = messages[messages.length - 1] || {}
      if (message.type === 'claim-coupon') {
        this.claimCoupon(message.couponId)
      }
      if (message.type === 'open-product') {
        this.openProduct(message.productId)
      }
    },
    claimCoupon (couponId) {
      wx.request({
        url: '/api/campaign/coupons/claim',
        method: 'POST',
        data: { campaignId: this.campaignId, couponId },
        success: () => {

        }

    },

      wx.navigateTo({
        url: `/packageProduct/pages/detail/index?id=${productId}&campaignId=${this.campaignId}`
      })
    },
    reloadCampaign () {
      const campaignUrl = this.campaignUrl
      this.campaignUrl = ''
      this.campaignUrl = campaignUrl
      this.loading = true
      this.errorText = ''
    },
    handleTrackerReady () {
      this.trackerReady = true
    },
    handleTrackerError () {
      this.trackerReady = false
    }
  }

item.text: 问题点已经明确：页面缺少“当前活动代次”和离页保护；追踪组件存在属性 observer/ready 双初始化、异步创建竞态以及监听不移除；消息没有校验来源和当前 iframe；Web 路由仍指向根目录。我会用活动会话代次、强制重挂载、请求/监听清理、严格 origin + source 校验，并把站点基路径统一为 `/mall/`。微信侧仍保留 `web-view bindmessage`、领券请求、商品跳转和埋点接口。
四个完整文件已写入。现在只对这四个声明的输出做静态复核，重点检查：所有监听是否成对移除、异步 tracker 是否能销毁晚到实例、旧请求回调是否被代次拦截，以及 `/mall/` 的资源和 history base 是否一致。

<template>
  <view class="tracker-state">
    <text>{{ready ? '活动追踪已就绪' : '活动追踪初始化中'}}</text>
  </view>
</template>

<script>
import { createComponent } from '@mpxjs/core'
import campaignTracker from '@business/campaign-tracker-web'

const CAMPAIGN_ORIGIN = 'https://campaign.example.com'

function isWebRuntime () {
  return typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof document !== 'undefined'
}

function getActiveCampaignWindow () {
  if (!isWebRuntime()) return null
  const node = document.getElementById('campaign-webview')
  if (!node) return null
  const iframe = String(node.tagName || '').toLowerCase() === 'iframe'
    ? node
    : (typeof node.querySelector === 'function' ? node.querySelector('iframe') : null)
  return iframe ? iframe.contentWindow : null
}

function safelyCall (target, method, ...args) {
  if (!target || typeof target[method] !== 'function') return
  try {
    const result = target[method](...args)
    if (result && typeof result.catch === 'function') result.catch(() => {})
  } catch (e) {}
}

createComponent({
  properties: {
    campaignId: {
      type: String,
      observer (value, oldValue) {
        if (value !== oldValue && this._trackerMounted) this.initTracker()
      }
    },
    memberId: {
      type: String,
      observer (value, oldValue) {
        if (value !== oldValue && this._trackerMounted) this.initTracker()
      }
    }
  },
  data: {
    ready: false
  },
  attached () {
    this._trackerMounted = true
    this._trackerGeneration = 0
    this._listenersAttached = false
  },
  ready () {
    this.attachListeners()
    this.initTracker()
  },
  detached () {
    this._trackerMounted = false
    this._trackerGeneration += 1
    this.detachListeners()
    this.disposeTracker()
  },
  methods: {
    attachListeners () {
      if (!isWebRuntime() || this._listenersAttached) return
      window.addEventListener('message', this.handleWindowMessage)
      document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', this.handleVisibilityChange)
      this._listenersAttached = true
    },
    detachListeners () {
      if (!isWebRuntime() || !this._listenersAttached) return
      window.removeEventListener('message', this.handleWindowMessage)
      document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', this.handleVisibilityChange)
      this._listenersAttached = false
    },
    disposeTracker () {
      const tracker = this.tracker
      this.tracker = null
      if (tracker) safelyCall(tracker, 'destroy')
    },
    async initTracker () {
      if (!this._trackerMounted || !this.campaignId) return

      const campaignId = this.campaignId
      const memberId = this.memberId
      const generation = ++this._trackerGeneration
      this.ready = false
      this.disposeTracker()

      let tracker
      try {
        tracker = await campaignTracker.create({ campaignId, memberId })
        if (
          !this._trackerMounted ||
          generation !== this._trackerGeneration ||
          campaignId !== this.campaignId ||
          memberId !== this.memberId
        ) {
          safelyCall(tracker, 'destroy')
          return
        }

        this.tracker = tracker
        safelyCall(tracker, 'start')
        if (!this._trackerMounted || generation !== this._trackerGeneration) {
          this.disposeTracker()
          return
        }
        this.ready = true
        this.triggerEvent('ready', { campaignId })
      } catch (error) {
        if (tracker) safelyCall(tracker, 'destroy')
        if (!this._trackerMounted || generation !== this._trackerGeneration) return
        this.ready = false
        this.triggerEvent('error', { campaignId })
      }
    },
    handleWindowMessage (event) {
      if (!this._trackerMounted || !this.tracker) return
      if (event.origin !== CAMPAIGN_ORIGIN) return
      const activeCampaignWindow = getActiveCampaignWindow()
      if (!activeCampaignWindow || event.source !== activeCampaignWindow) return

      const message = event.data && typeof event.data === 'object' ? event.data : null
      if (!message || message.type !== 'campaign-exposure') return
      if (message.campaignId && message.campaignId !== this.campaignId) return
      safelyCall(this.tracker, 'track', 'exposure', message.payload)
    },
    handleVisibilityChange () {
      if (!this._trackerMounted || !this.tracker) return
      safelyCall(this.tracker, document.hidden ? 'pause' : 'resume')
    }
  }
})
</script>

      bindmessage="handleCampaignMessage"
      bindload="handleCampaignLoad"

      campaignId="{{campaignId}}"
      memberId="{{memberId}}"
      bindready="handleTrackerReady"
      binderror="handleTrackerError"
    />
  </view>

<script>
import { createPage } from '@mpxjs/core'

const CAMPAIGN_ORIGIN = 'https://campaign.example.com'

const CAMPAIGN_DETAILS = {
  'summer-sale': {
    title: '夏日清凉特卖',
    subtitle: '限时领券，爆款低至五折'
  },
  'member-day': {
    title: '会员专享日',
    subtitle: '会员好礼与专享优惠限时开放'
  },
  'fresh-week': {
    title: '生鲜周',
    subtitle: '当季鲜货，每日限量特惠'
  }
}

function isWebRuntime () {
  return typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof document !== 'undefined'
}

function getIframeFromNode (node) {
  if (!node || typeof node !== 'object') return null
  if (String(node.tagName || '').toLowerCase() === 'iframe') return node
  if (typeof node.querySelector === 'function') return node.querySelector('iframe')
  return null
}

createPage({
  data: {
    memberId: 'member-10086',
    campaignId: 'summer-sale',
    campaigns: [
      { id: 'summer-sale', name: '夏日特卖' },
      { id: 'member-day', name: '会员日' },
      { id: 'fresh-week', name: '生鲜周' }
    ],
    campaign: CAMPAIGN_DETAILS['summer-sale'],
    campaignUrl: '',
    webviewKey: 0,
    loading: true,
    errorText: '',
    trackerReady: false
  },
  onLoad () {
    this._pageActive = true
    this._campaignGeneration = 0
    this._requestTasks = new Set()
    this._handleWebMessage = (event) => this.handleCampaignMessage(event)
    if (isWebRuntime()) {
      window.addEventListener('message', this._handleWebMessage)
    }
    this.activateCampaign(this.campaignId)
  },
  onUnload () {
    this._pageActive = false
    this._campaignGeneration += 1
    if (isWebRuntime() && this._handleWebMessage) {
      window.removeEventListener('message', this._handleWebMessage)
    }
    this._handleWebMessage = null
    if (this._requestTasks) {
      this._requestTasks.forEach((task) => {
        if (task && typeof task.abort === 'function') task.abort()
      })
      this._requestTasks.clear()
    }
  },
  methods: {
    buildCampaignUrl (campaignId, generation) {
      return `${CAMPAIGN_ORIGIN}/${encodeURIComponent(campaignId)}?memberId=${encodeURIComponent(this.memberId)}&campaignSession=${generation}`
    },
    activateCampaign (campaignId) {
      if (!this._pageActive || !CAMPAIGN_DETAILS[campaignId]) return

      const generation = ++this._campaignGeneration
      this.campaignId = campaignId
      this.campaign = CAMPAIGN_DETAILS[campaignId]
      this.loading = true
      this.errorText = ''
      this.trackerReady = false

      // 先销毁旧 web-view，再挂载带唯一会话参数的新实例，避免旧页面事件晚到。
      this.campaignUrl = ''
      this.$nextTick(() => {
        if (!this._pageActive || generation !== this._campaignGeneration) return
        this.webviewKey = generation
        this.campaignUrl = this.buildCampaignUrl(campaignId, generation)
      })
    },
    switchCampaign (campaignId) {
      if (campaignId === this.campaignId) return
      this.activateCampaign(campaignId)
    },
    getActiveIframe () {
      if (!isWebRuntime()) return null
      return getIframeFromNode(document.getElementById('campaign-webview'))
    },
    isCurrentWebviewEvent (event) {
      if (!this._pageActive) return false
      if (!isWebRuntime()) return true

      const activeIframe = this.getActiveIframe()
      if (!activeIframe) return false

      const eventTarget = event && (event.target || event.currentTarget)
      const eventIframe = getIframeFromNode(eventTarget)
      if (eventIframe && eventIframe !== activeIframe) return false
      if (eventTarget && typeof eventTarget.isConnected === 'boolean' && !eventTarget.isConnected) return false

      const sourceUrl = activeIframe.getAttribute('src') || activeIframe.src || ''
      return sourceUrl === this.campaignUrl || activeIframe.src === this.campaignUrl
    },
    handleCampaignLoad (event) {
      if (!this.isCurrentWebviewEvent(event)) return
      this.loading = false
      wx.reportAnalytics('campaign_webview_load', {
        campaign_id: this.campaignId
      })
    },
    handleCampaignError (event) {
      if (!this.isCurrentWebviewEvent(event)) return
      this.loading = false
      this.errorText = '活动会场暂时无法打开'
    },
    getMessageData (event) {
      if (isWebRuntime()) {
        // Web 只接收原生 MessageEvent；bindmessage 的二次包装会因缺少可信来源被忽略。
        if (!event || event.origin !== CAMPAIGN_ORIGIN) return null
        const activeIframe = this.getActiveIframe()
        if (!activeIframe || event.source !== activeIframe.contentWindow) return null
        return event.data && typeof event.data === 'object' ? event.data : null
      }

      const messages = event && event.detail && Array.isArray(event.detail.data)
        ? event.detail.data
        : []
      const message = messages[messages.length - 1]
      return message && typeof message === 'object' ? message : null
    },
    handleCampaignMessage (event) {
      if (!this._pageActive) return
      const message = this.getMessageData(event)
      if (!message) return
      if (message.campaignId && message.campaignId !== this.campaignId) return

      if (message.type === 'claim-coupon') {
        this.claimCoupon(message.couponId)
      } else if (message.type === 'open-product') {
        this.openProduct(message.productId)
      }
    },
    claimCoupon (couponId) {
      if (typeof couponId !== 'string' || !couponId) return
      const generation = this._campaignGeneration
      const campaignId = this.campaignId
      let requestTask
      requestTask = wx.request({
        url: '/api/campaign/coupons/claim',
        method: 'POST',
        data: { campaignId, couponId },
        success: () => {
          if (!this._pageActive || generation !== this._campaignGeneration) return
          wx.showToast({ title: '领取成功', icon: 'success' })
        },
        complete: () => {
          if (this._requestTasks) this._requestTasks.delete(requestTask)
        }
      })
      if (requestTask && this._requestTasks) this._requestTasks.add(requestTask)
    },
    openProduct (productId) {
      if (typeof productId !== 'string' || !productId || !this._pageActive) return
      wx.navigateTo({
        url: `/packageProduct/pages/detail/index?id=${encodeURIComponent(productId)}&campaignId=${encodeURIComponent(this.campaignId)}`
      })
    },
    reloadCampaign () {
      this.activateCampaign(this.campaignId)
    },
    handleTrackerReady (event) {
      const readyCampaignId = event && event.detail && event.detail.campaignId
      if (!this._pageActive || (readyCampaignId && readyCampaignId !== this.campaignId)) return
      this.trackerReady = true
    },
    handleTrackerError (event) {
      const errorCampaignId = event && event.detail && event.detail.campaignId
      if (!this._pageActive || (errorCampaignId && errorCampaignId !== this.campaignId)) return
      this.trackerReady = false
    }
  }
})
</script>
